subject: DI04000241

body.en:
Start with the situation

A shaft needs cylindrical steps, a faced end and a groove. One controlled work axis can generate all three.

Definition / principle

A lathe removes material with a cutting tool while the work normally rotates about the spindle axis.

Understand why

Spindle rotation supplies cutting speed; longitudinal/cross-feed and tool position define the generated surface.

Application / illustration

The same lathe can turn, face, thread, bore and drill when suitable tooling and support are used.

Common mistake / conditions

In ordinary tailstock drilling on a lathe, the drill may be stationary while the work rotates; do not copy the pillar-drill motion blindly.

Why divide diameter reduction by2?

Radial depth is measured on one side of the axis; diameter includes both sides.
body.gu:
પરિસ્થિતિથી શરૂઆત

Shaftમાં cylindrical steps,faced end,groove જોઈએ.એક controlled work axisથી ત્રણેય બનાવી શકાય.

Definition / Principle

Latheમાં work સામાન્ય રીતે spindle axis આસપાસ rotate થાય અને cutting tool material દૂર કરે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Spindle rotation cutting speed આપે;longitudinal/cross-feed,tool position surface નક્કી કરે.

Application / ઉદાહરણ

Suitable tooling/supportથી same lathe પર turning,facing,threading,boring,drilling થાય.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Ordinary tailstock drillingમાં drill stationary,work rotating હોઈ શકે;pillar-drill motion અંધપણે ન લખો.

Diameter Reductionને2થી કેમ ભાગીએ?

Radial depth axisની એક બાજુનું માપ છે;diameterમાં બન્ને બાજુ આવે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A centre lathe combines a rigid bed, geared spindle and controllable tool feeds.

Construction:part and purpose

The bed and guideways locate headstock, tailstock and carriage on a common reference.

An enclosed headstock gear train provides selected spindle speed ranges.

The spindle nose accepts a compatible chuck, faceplate or centre arrangement.

The tailstock quill supports a centre or holds suitable axial tools.

The saddle, apron, cross-slide and compound carry and position the tool.

A feed gearbox/feed rod supplies ordinary feeds; leadscrew and half-nuts synchronise thread cutting.

Guards, lubrication, controls and emergency stop support approved safe operation.

Working:flow and reason

Approved workholding locates and grips the blank with appropriate support.

Motor power passes through selected headstock gears to the spindle.

The spindle rotates work against a correctly mounted cutting edge.

Carriage longitudinal feed produces cylindrical surfaces along the axis.

Cross-slide radial motion faces the end or controls infeed.

Thread mode relates spindle rotation to leadscrew motion instead of treating feed as independent.

After a safe stop, measure size/finish and record deviations before any approved adjustment.

Common mistake / conditions

Never touch rotating work or change unapproved gear settings in motion; follow machine-specific guarding and isolation.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Centre latheમાં rigid bed,geared spindle,controllable tool feeds જોડાય છે.

Construction:ભાગ અને કામ

Bed,guideways headstock,tailstock,carriageને common reference પર રાખે.

Enclosed headstock gear train selected spindle speed ranges આપે.

Spindle nose compatible chuck,faceplate,centre arrangement લે.

Tailstock quill centre support કે suitable axial tools રાખે.

Saddle,apron,cross-slide,compound toolને carry/position કરે.

Feed gearbox/feed rod ordinary feed આપે;leadscrew,half-nuts thread cutting synchronise કરે.

Guards,lubrication,controls,emergency stop approved safe operationમાં મદદ કરે.

Working:Flow અને કારણ

Approved workholding blankને locate/grip કરે,યોગ્ય support આપે.

Motor power selected headstock gearsથી spindle સુધી જાય.

Spindle workને correctly mounted cutting edge સામે ફેરવે.

Carriage longitudinal feed axisની સાથે cylindrical surfaces બનાવે.

Cross-slide radial motion end facing કે infeed control કરે.

Thread mode spindle rotationને leadscrew motion સાથે જોડે;feed independent નથી.

Safe stop પછી size/finish માપી deviation નોંધો,પછી approved adjustment કરો.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Rotating workને અડવું કે motionમાં unapproved gear change નહિ;machine-specific guarding,isolation પાળો.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Capacity, speed/feed ranges, power and accuracy all influence suitability.

Understand why

Swing over bed is the maximum nominal diameter clearing the bed; carriage swing is usually smaller.

Distance between centres limits a supported work length; spindle bore limits through-bar capacity.

Illustrative specification:swing300mm, centres750mm, bore40mm, speed45–1800rev/min, motor3kW.

Also state spindle taper/nose, feed ranges, metric/inch thread capability, tailstock taper and accessories.

Common mistake / conditions

These are sample values, not the specification of an actually inspected machine.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Capacity,speed/feed ranges,power,accuracyથી suitability નક્કી થાય.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Swing over bed bedને clear કરતો maximum nominal diameter;carriage swing સામાન્ય રીતે ઓછો.

Distance between centres supported length મર્યાદિત કરે;spindle bore through-bar capacity મર્યાદિત કરે.

Illustrative specification:swing300mm,centres750mm,bore40mm,speed45–1800rev/min,motor3kW.

Spindle taper/nose,feed ranges,metric/inch thread capability,tailstock taper,accessories પણ લખો.

Common Mistake / શરતો

આ sample values છે,ખરેખર inspected machineની specification નથી.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Follow power transmission rather than just memorising part names.

Understand why

Motor→headstock speed gears→spindle→work establishes cutting rotation.

Spindle take-off→change gears/feed gearbox→feed rod→apron→carriage/cross-feed establishes ordinary feed.

For threading, the leadscrew and engaged half-nuts provide carriage travel with a fixed relation to spindle revolutions.

Idler gears can alter direction without altering a simple gear train speed-ratio magnitude; compound trains require every driver/driven ratio.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

ફક્ત part names નહિ,power transmission trace કરો.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Motor→headstock speed gears→spindle→work cutting rotation આપે.

Spindle take-off→change gears/feed gearbox→feed rod→apron→carriage/cross-feed ordinary feed આપે.

Threadingમાં leadscrew,engaged half-nuts carriage travelને spindle revolutions સાથે fixed relation આપે.

Idler simple trainની ratio magnitude બદલ્યા વગર direction બદલે;compound trainમાં દરેક driver/driven ratio લેવો પડે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Choose locating accuracy, grip geometry and adjustment capability to match the job.

Understand why

3-jaw self-centring chuck moves jaws together; convenient for round/hexagonal work but not automatically zero-runout.

4-jaw independent chuck permits irregular/eccentric work and individual centring by indication.

Collet grips a limited size range with distributed contact; suited to repetitive small-bar work within its capacity.

A faceplate carries awkward work with approved clamps and balance consideration; avoid protrusion/collision risks.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Job પ્રમાણે locating accuracy,grip geometry,adjustment capability પસંદ કરો.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

3-jaw self-centringમાં jaws સાથે ચાલે;round/hexagonal work માટે અનુકૂળ,પણ zero-runoutની ખાતરી નહિ.

4-jaw independentમાં irregular/eccentric work,indicationથી individual centring થાય.

Collet limited size rangeમાં distributed contact આપે;capacityની અંદર repetitive small-bar workમાં ઉપયોગી.

Faceplate awkward workને approved clampsથી રાખે;balance,protrusion/collision risks ધ્યાનમાં લો.

h.en: 2.1.6 Centres, rests, mandrels and driving devices

body.en:
Definition / principle

Support and torque transmission are related but different jobs.

Understand why

Centres locate suitable centre-drilled work; the drive must still transmit torque through an approved arrangement.

Driving plate and dog drive work between centres; exposed dogs/projections require guarding.

A steady rest is bed-mounted; follower rest travels with the carriage. Both limit deflection of slender work.

A mandrel locates work through a finished bore so an outside surface can be machined relative to that bore.

Excessive gripping/support force can distort thin work; support settings need the approved procedure.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Support આપવું અને torque પહોંચાડવું જુદાં પણ જોડાયેલા કામ છે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Centres suitable centre-drilled work locate કરે;torque માટે approved drive arrangement હજી જોઈએ.

Driving plate,dog centres વચ્ચે workને drive કરે;exposed dog/projections માટે guarding જોઈએ.

Steady rest bed-mounted;follower rest carriage સાથે ચાલે.બન્ને slender workનું deflection ઘટાડે.

Mandrel finished boreથી work locate કરે જેથી બહારની surface boreના referenceમાં machine થાય.

વધુ gripping/support force thin work distort કરે;support settings approved procedure મુજબ હોવાં જોઈએ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Tool motion and geometry distinguish operations that may look similar in a photograph.

Understand why

Plain/step turning makes outside cylinders; facing makes an end plane normal to the axis.

Grooving makes a recess; parting separates a portion using controlled radial cutting.

Boring enlarges an existing hole; drilling creates a hole; reaming finishes a prepared hole with a small allowance.

Threading forms a helix with synchronised axial travel; knurling usually displaces material rather than cutting it.

Chamfering removes an edge at an angle; form turning reproduces the tool profile within load and rigidity limits.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Photoમાં સમાન લાગતાં operationsને tool motion,geometryથી જુદા ઓળખો.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Plain/step turning બહાર cylinder બનાવે;facing axisને normal end plane બનાવે.

Grooving recess બનાવે;parting controlled radial cuttingથી ભાગ અલગ કરે.

Boring existing hole મોટું કરે;drilling hole બનાવે;reaming prepared holeને નાના allowanceથી finish કરે.

Threading synchronised axial travelથી helix બનાવે;knurling સામાન્ય રીતે material displace કરે,cut નહિ.

Chamfering angled edge બનાવે;form turning load/rigidity limitsમાં tool profile reproduce કરે.

title.gu: 2.2 Tapers અને Threads:Geometryથી Motion નક્કી થાય

body.en:
Definition / principle

An axial change of diameter produces a cone or frustum; use the half-angle to the axis.

Understand why

Taper per unit length=(D−d)/l; tan(alpha)=(D−d)/(2l).

Compound-rest swivelling suits relatively short tapers; tool travel follows the compound setting.

Tailstock set-over tilts supported work for a long small external taper; it does not serve internal tapers.

A taper attachment guides cross-slide movement relative to carriage travel; its capacity/settings constrain the taper.

A form tool cuts its profile radially; wide contact raises force/chatter risk, so it mainly suits short features.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Axisની સાથે diameter બદલાય તો cone/frustum બને;axis સામે half-angle લો.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Unit lengthદીઠ taper=(D−d)/l;tan(alpha)=(D−d)/(2l).

Compound-rest swivelling relatively short taper માટે;tool travel compound setting અનુસરે.

Tailstock set-over supported workને tilt કરીને long small external taper આપે;internal taper માટે નહિ.

Taper attachment carriage travel સામે cross-slide guide કરે;capacity/settings taper મર્યાદિત કરે.

Form tool profileને radially cut કરે;wide contact force/chatter વધારે,મુખ્યત્વે short featuresમાં યોગ્ય.

body.en:
Given and model

D40mm, d30mm, taper length100mm, distance between centresL500mm; small-angle set-over model.

Step-by-step solution

  1. tan(alpha)=(40−30)/(2×100)=.05
  2. alpha=atan(.05)=2.8624degrees; included angle=5.7248degrees
  3. Set-over e≈L(D−d)/(2l)=500×10/200=25mm

Common mistake / conditions

25mm may exceed a real machine allowance; this is a geometry example, not permission to apply that setting. Check travel, centre contact and maker limits.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

D40mm,d30mm,taper length100mm,centres distance L500mm;small-angle set-over model.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. tan(alpha)=(40−30)/(2×100)=.05
  2. alpha=atan(.05)=2.8624degrees;included angle=5.7248degrees
  3. Set-over e≈L(D−d)/(2l)=500×10/200=25mm

Common Mistake / શરતો

Real machineમાં25mm allowance બહાર હોઈ શકે;આ geometry example છે,setting કરવાની permission નહિ.Travel,centre contact,maker limits તપાસો.

body.en:
Definition / principle

For a single-start thread, the tool must advance one pitch for each work revolution.

Understand why

Thread lead=pitch×number of starts. For multi-start threads, use lead in the carriage-travel ratio.

Choose a tool form compatible with the thread standard and correct centre-height/alignment under supervision.

Choose the gearbox/change gears so leadscrew speed/spindle speed=required thread lead/leadscrew lead.

Half-nuts couple the carriage to the leadscrew; safe re-engagement depends on screw/thread system and machine instructions.

Provide approved run-out/clearance and avoid collision; do not assume one thread-dial rule works for metric, inch and conversion threading.

Pitch2mm, two starts:use what lead?

4mm lead; using2mm would give the wrong synchronisation.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Single-start threadમાં workના એક revolutionદીઠ tool એક pitch આગળ જવું જોઈએ.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Thread lead=pitch×startsની સંખ્યા.Multi-startમાં carriage-travel ratio માટે lead લો.

Thread standardને અનુરૂપ tool form,correct centre-height/alignment supervised રીતે પસંદ કરો.

Gearbox/change gears એવા લો કે leadscrew speed/spindle speed=required thread lead/leadscrew lead.

Half-nuts carriageને leadscrew સાથે જોડે;safe re-engagement screw/thread system,machine instructions પર આધારિત છે.

Approved run-out/clearance રાખી collision ટાળો;metric,inch,conversion threading માટે એક thread-dial rule ન માનો.

Pitch2mm,Two Startsમાં કયું Lead?

Lead4mm;2mmથી synchronisation ખોટું થાય.

body.en:
Given and model

Leadscrew lead6mm, required single-start pitch1.5mm. Assume a direct simple train or a stated compound train.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Required nLS/nS=1.5/6=.25
  2. Simple train:driver20 teeth/driven80 teeth=.25
  3. Compound example:(20/40)×(30/60)=.25

Common mistake / conditions

The actual gear set, centres, meshing, rotation direction and guards must suit the machine. A ratio alone is not a complete installation plan.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

Leadscrew lead6mm,required single-start pitch1.5mm.Direct simple train કે stated compound train લો.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Required nLS/nS=1.5/6=.25
  2. Simple train:driver20 teeth/driven80 teeth=.25
  3. Compound example:(20/40)×(30/60)=.25

Common Mistake / શરતો

Actual gear set,centres,meshing,rotation direction,guards machineને અનુરૂપ હોવાં જોઈએ;ratio એકલું installation plan નથી.

h.en: 2.2.5 Turning time and exact annular MRR
h.gu: 2.2.5 Turning Time અને Exact Annular MRR

body.en:
Given and model

Turn D50→46mm over100mm; allow5mm total approach/overtravel; N200rev/min, f.25mm/rev, one pass.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Radial depth=(50−46)/2=2mm; feed rate=.25×200=50mm/min
  2. Cutting time=(100+5)/50=2.1min
  3. Exact steady MRR=(pi/4)(50²−46²)×50=15079.645mm³/min
  4. Using mean diameter48mm:pi×48×200×.25×2=15079.645mm³/min

Common mistake / conditions

Pure cutting time excludes setup, measurement, tool changes and idle return. Multiply/add separately for multiple passes with their own conditions.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

D50→46mm,length100mm,total approach/overtravel5mm;N200rev/min,f.25mm/rev,એક pass.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Radial depth=(50−46)/2=2mm;feed rate=.25×200=50mm/min
  2. Cutting time=(100+5)/50=2.1min
  3. Exact steady MRR=(pi/4)(50²−46²)×50=15079.645mm³/min
  4. Using mean diameter48mm:pi×48×200×.25×2=15079.645mm³/min

Common Mistake / શરતો

Pure cutting timeમાં setup,measurement,tool change,idle return નથી.Multiple passes માટે તેમની conditions મુજબ અલગ સમય ઉમેરો.

body.en:
Given and model

Face diameter60mm to centre at constant N300rev/min, f.2mm/rev, neglect allowances.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Radial travel=60/2=30mm
  2. Time=30/(.2×300)=.5min

Common mistake / conditions

At constant RPM, cutting speed falls toward the centre. This example is not constant-surface-speed control.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

Diameter60mmથી centre સુધી facing;constant N300rev/min,f.2mm/rev,allowances અવગણો.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Radial travel=60/2=30mm
  2. Time=30/(.2×300)=.5min

Common Mistake / શરતો

Constant RPMમાં centre તરફ cutting speed ઘટે.આ constant-surface-speed control નથી.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Link drawing, datum, holding, tools, parameters and inspection in a justified sequence.

Understand why

Read tolerances, finish, stock allowance and features; choose a datum and secure/support the blank.

Plan facing/roughing/finishing/holes/threads as appropriate; leave finishing allowances rather than cutting every size at once.

Use recommended speed/feed/depth for the stated tool-work pair; check available speed, power, rigidity and safe clearance.

Calculate RPM, feed rate, pass count and cutting time; inspect only after safe stopping.

Report real measurements only if actually obtained; paper examples do not prove a manufactured part meets tolerance.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Drawing,datum,holding,tools,parameters,inspectionને કારણ સાથે sequenceમાં જોડો.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Tolerances,finish,stock allowance,features વાંચો;datum,secure holding/support લો.

યોગ્ય facing/roughing/finishing/holes/threads plan કરો;finishing allowance રાખો.

Stated tool-work pairના recommended speed/feed/depth લો;available speed,power,rigidity,safe clearance જુઓ.

RPM,feed rate,pass count,cutting time ગણો;safe stop પછી જ inspect કરો.

ખરેખર લીધાં હોય તે જ readings report કરો;paper exampleથી part toleranceમાં છે તે સાબિત નહિ.

h.en: 2.3.1 Compound-rest swivelling:how the taper is generated
h.gu: 2.3.1 Compound-rest Swivellingથી Taper કેવી રીતે બને?

body.en:
Definition / principle

The compound slide is set at the required half-angle so its tool feed follows the cone generator.

Understand why

The compound base, graduated swivel, slide and toolpost establish a guided short angled travel.

The work rotates about the normal spindle axis while the tool moves along the inclined compound.

The angle used is to the machine axis; included taper angle must be halved when that is the supplied quantity.

Advantages:external or suitable internal short tapers and relatively large angles. Limitation:compound travel and commonly manual feed.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Compound slide required half-angle પર set થાય જેથી tool feed cone generator અનુસરે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Compound base,graduated swivel,slide,toolpost guided short angled travel આપે.

Work normal spindle axis પર ફરે;tool inclined compound પર ચાલે.

Angle machine axis સામેનો છે;supplied included angle હોય તો અડધો લો.

લાભ:short external/suitable internal taper,relatively large angles.Limitation:compound travel,સામાન્ય રીતે manual feed.

h.gu: 2.3.2 Tailstock Set-overમાં Axis કેમ Tilt થાય?

body.en:
Definition / principle

Offsetting the tailstock centre tilts work between centres relative to carriage travel.

Understand why

The headstock centre and laterally adjustable tailstock centre support the work; an approved drive transmits torque.

Carriage feed stays parallel to the bed, but it cuts an inclined work axis, producing an external taper.

Use the total between-centres lengthL and actual taper lengthl in e≈L(D−d)/(2l); they are not generally equal.

It suits long small tapers within safe offset/contact limits; restore alignment afterward by the approved procedure.

Common mistake / conditions

This cannot generate an internal taper and can impair centre contact if offset is excessive.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Tailstock centre offset કરવાથી centres વચ્ચેનું work carriage travel સામે tilt થાય.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Headstock centre,laterally adjustable tailstock centre support આપે;approved drive torque આપે.

Carriage feed bedને parallel રહે,પણ inclined work axis cut થવાથી external taper બને.

e≈L(D−d)/(2l)માં total centres length L,actual taper length l લો;સામાન્ય રીતે same નથી.

Safe offset/contact limitsમાં long small taper માટે;પછી approved procedureથી alignment restore કરો.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Internal taper માટે નહિ;વધુ offsetથી centre contact બગડે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

An attachment guides tool motion; a form tool supplies a cutting-edge profile.

Understand why

The taper attachment has a settable guide bar, slider and connection controlling cross-slide displacement during carriage travel.

With the machine-specific linkage arrangement, the guide makes radial tool position change with axial travel without offsetting the work axis.

The form-tool method feeds a shaped edge radially so the edge profile is reproduced over a short taper.

Attachment capacity limits length/angle; form cutting is limited by wide-contact forces, chatter and tool/work rigidity.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Attachment tool motion guide કરે;form tool cutting-edge profile આપે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Taper attachmentમાં settable guide bar,slider,connection carriage travel દરમિયાન cross-slide displacement control કરે.

Machine-specific linkageમાં guideથી work axis offset કર્યા વગર axial travel સાથે radial position બદલાય.

Form-tool methodમાં shaped edge radially feed થાય,short taper પર edge profile reproduce થાય.

Attachment capacity length/angle મર્યાદિત કરે;form cuttingમાં wide-contact forces,chatter,rigidity limits હોય.

body.en:
Given and model

D60→50mm over100mm, total travel105mm/pass, max radial roughing depth2mm; N250, f.2 for every pass in this simplified case.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Total radial stock=(60−50)/2=5mm
  2. Pass depths=2+2+1mm; pass count=3
  3. Time per pass=105/(.2×250)=2.1min
  4. Total cutting time=3×2.1=6.3min

Common mistake / conditions

A real finishing pass may need another feed, stock and speed; recalculate each pass when conditions differ.

Can setup time be ignored in production quotation?

Not generally. Pure cutting time is only one part of total production time.
body.gu:

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Total radial stock=(60−50)/2=5mm
  2. Pass depths=2+2+1mm;pass count=3
  3. Time per pass=105/(.2×250)=2.1min
  4. Total cutting time=3×2.1=6.3min

Common Mistake / શરતો

Real finishing passમાં feed,stock,speed જુદાં હોઈ શકે;conditions જુદી હોય તો દરેક pass ફરી ગણો.

Production Quotationમાં Setup Time અવગણાય?

સામાન્ય રીતે નહિ.Pure cutting time total production timeનો એક ભાગ છે.
